title: Eval row EV-page-file-size-windows turns good once the corpus holds fewer Windows units (window share 0.2007 at f980ac7c6)
goal: The tuned lookup eval passes again: the key word window stays informative in the Windows page-file question, so the pack for it is weak and not good. At f980ac7c6 window was in 3804 of 18955 units, 0.2007 against COMMON_SHARE 0.2 in kbfacts.py; adding the four zsh articles (about 215 units, a few mentioning Windows) took it under 0.2, so the question gained an informative key word and the pack turned good with a check: line (best facts from ldap-paging-filters and the agent error catalogue).
